content.title: About
content.content: Fat‑free spaghetti sauce is a ready‑to‑use tomato sauce made without added plant or animal fats. It contains ripe tomatoes, onion, garlic, herbs and spices, and a small amount of sugar to balance flavor. The product is suitable for low‑fat diets and can serve as a quick base for pasta dishes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The sauce contains virtually 0 g of fat while preserving the classic Italian flavor.
Tomatoes used in the recipe are rich in lycopene, an antioxidant that supports heart health.
The product is gluten‑free and suitable for most people with food sensitivities.
Only natural herbs such as basil and oregano are used, with no artificial flavorings.
It can be heated in a microwave or on the stove in 2–3 minutes.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The absence of fat makes the sauce appropriate for calorie‑restricted diets and weight management.

items.title: Rich in lycopene
items.content: Lycopene present in tomatoes has antioxidant properties and may help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Source of vitamin C
items.content: Tomatoes provide a good amount of vitamin C, which supports the immune system.

items.title: Aids digestion
items.content: Tomatoes and spices stimulate gastric juice production, improving digestion.

items.title: Moderate sodium
items.content: The sauce contains a modest amount of salt, beneficial for blood pressure control.

items.title: Tomato allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to tomatoes or other ingredients in the sauce.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although small, the sugar should be considered by people monitoring blood glucose levels.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Tomatoes are naturally acidic, which can cause discomfort for those with gastritis or reflux.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the sauce in a saucepan or microwave, pour over cooked spaghetti and stir. It can be enhanced with fresh herbs, grated Parmesan, or vegetables. The sauce also works as a base for casseroles, lasagna, and seafood dishes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the sauce in its sealed container in the refrigerator at 0 °C–4 °C. Once opened, use within 5–7 days. For longer storage, freeze up to 3 months in an airtight container.
